properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
properties.notes: Industrial premises and associated outbuildings and land, latterly utilised as premises for a timber merchant, but originally a joiners workshop. The site has also been utilised for storage of caravans. Permission granted for redevelopment of site for 6 homes following demolition of the existing buildings (03/00336/FUL). Subject to long build-out programme, will 3 units completed in 2009 and 2010, followed by a number of years of inactivity prior to the next unit being finished in 2018. Development of 6 dwellings completed in 2019/20.
